item.text: I’ll test the two posts that clearly describe the album and where it can be streamed. That should help attract listeners who know what they’re clicking through to. The ads will target Ireland and the UK, with $225 lifetime caps per ad group and an end time of midnight after 31 October, accounting for Dublin’s clock change.

item.text: The first check shows $65.18 spent for 26 link clicks. Both posts have similar click costs so far. I’ll narrow one ad group to music interests and the other to relevant music and Samhain keywords to test whether stronger relevance improves the response.

Since the targeting change, the keyword group has delivered 47 link clicks at about $1.25 each; the music-interest group has delivered 31 at about $1.53 each. I’ll shift the remaining allocation modestly toward the keyword group, keeping the combined lifetime caps at $450. Stream performance remains unmeasured.

Spend is now $259.39, with 155 link clicks. The keyword group still has the lower click cost. I’ll continue the daily checks and retire the “before the 31st” post before Halloween begins, then use the factual album post for the final day.

item.text: The “before the 31st” post has stopped, and the factual album post is running for Halloween. Reported spend is $395.33 with 248 link clicks so far. I’ll check once more this evening and stop the campaign at midnight Dublin time.
The campaign has ended and both ad groups are paused. I’ll pull the closing totals after allowing another hour for reporting to update.

Campaign completed for 23–31 October, Dublin time, with daily monitoring. All ads are paused.

- Spend: **$443.90 USD** of $450
- Impressions: **300,242**
- Link clicks: **273**

Only approved posts were used, targeting Ireland and the UK. Streams couldn’t be measured; link clicks aren’t stream counts.
